name: Switzerland (Swissmedic)

changes.notes: Nine more quiz questions in the shared module (every lesson now has at least eight). No rule changes. Source links checked on 2026-10-17: moved pages updated and secondary sources replaced with official ones where they exist.

about: The information for healthcare professionals (Fachinformation, AMZV Annex 4) and the patient information (Patienteninformation, Annex 5.1). Headings and the standard statements are given in German, as Swissmedic publishes them; the practice body text is in English. Official texts are in German, French and Italian.

watch.title: ElViS 2.0
watch.text: Swissmedic plans to replace its ElViS reporting portal with ElViS 2.0 (E2B(R3)) on 21 December 2026. The reporting text in the Fachinformation names ElViS; the app accepts either name.

sources.title: Arzneimittel-Zulassungsverordnung (AMZV, SR 812.212.22): Annex 4 (Fachinformation), Annex 5.1 (Patienteninformation), Art. 14a (additional monitoring)
